verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Knowledge Graph is documented to continuously generate insights that highlight anomalies, errors and saturation without hand-written PromQL, which matches the core of the story. Evidence is thin on the details: nothing shows how anomaly detection is enabled or configured, the algorithms used, or anomaly-based alert rules, and it appears only in the Cloud docs. missing for 10: documented anomaly/outlier detection feeding alert rules, configuration and enablement details, detection method/depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: It continuously generates insights that highlight saturation, errors, anomalies, failures, and configuration changes—eliminating the need to write complex PromQL queries
generating insights about issues, and connecting metrics, logs, and traces in a unified workflow—no complex queries required.
The Kubernetes Overview page surfaces what needs triage without making you dig through dashboards.
